items.title: Microsoft turns to AWS as GitHub faces AI capacity crunch
items.author: ilreb
items.summary: Microsoft added AWS capacity to GitHub due to AI-driven growth causing infrastructure strain. GitHub faced reliability issues and stopped new subscriptions for Copilot plans. Microsoft's move to a multi-cloud strategy aims to avoid over-reliance on a single provider.

items.title: TinyWind: A pixel pirate sailing game with real wind physics (380k+ kms sailed)
items.author: tinywind
items.summary: TinyWind is a pixel pirate sailing game featuring realistic wind physics. It has sailed over 380,000 km. The game received feedback on wind direction and sail control.

items.title: Ask HN: Has anyone replaced Claude/GPT with a local model for daily coding?
items.author: cloudking
items.text: Has anyone here fully swapped Claude/GPT for a local model as their main coding tool, not just for side experiments? If so, please share your setup and performance (e.g tok/s)
items.summary: Some developers have replaced remote AI tools like Claude with local models for coding, finding them cost-effective and efficient. Local models can handle many tasks without needing cloud services. This shift often reduces monthly expenses significantly.

items.title: Why I email complete strangers
items.author: karakoram
items.summary: Emailing complete strangers can foster connections, collaborations, and new opportunities. It often involves brief introductions, clear requests, and offers of mutual benefit. This practice can lead to unexpected professional or personal relationships.

items.author: rsgm
items.summary: Self-hosting AI models on a homelab is practical; n8n can automate workflows; consider Ollama for local AI processing.

items.title: Peopleless economy? Not technically impossible
items.author: l0new0lf-G
items.summary: A peopleless economy is technically feasible with advanced AI, but it poses significant risks to employment and economic stability. Full automation could lead to widespread job loss. The transition requires careful management to mitigate negative impacts.

items.title: Hetzner Price Adjustment
items.author: tuhtah
items.summary: Hetzner announced a price increase effective April 1, 2026, for both new and existing products. The price hike applies to cloud servers and object storage. The increase aims to cover rising operational costs.

items.title: Show HN: Veterinarian turned founder, AI lawn diagnosis
items.author: andrewbr
items.text:
I know, it's kind of weird. What is a veterinarian doing creating an analysis tool for lawn problems?

Frankly, the idea was born of my own lawn care struggles. Endless lawn care company fees without any actual improvement. Googling problems and finding generic solutions without regional considerations. One time I overseeded my grass not realizing I had to actually put soil down too.

One day, I decided to run lawn pictures through AI and found some pretty helpful information. So I decide
items.summary: A veterinarian turned founder has developed an AI system for diagnosing lawn issues. The project aims to help homeowners manage their lawns more effectively. The AI leverages machine learning to identify problems and suggest solutions.

items.title: Salesforce to Acquire Fin (formerly Intercom) for $3.6B
items.author: colesantiago
items.summary: Salesforce announced its acquisition of Fin, formerly Intercom, for $3.6 billion. The deal is expected to close in Q4 FY 2027. Fin's AI technology will enhance Salesforce's Agentforce platform.

items.title: Game Engine White Papers Commander Keen
items.author: mfiguiere
items.summary: Commander Keen used a custom game engine, and white papers on it were published by Bas Smits. The engine was notable for its smooth scrolling technology.

items.title: Claude Corps
items.author: Mustan
items.summary: Claude Corps is a national fellowship program for early-career professionals to apply AI in public-interest work. Applications for the first cohort are open until July 17, 2026. The first cohort will start in October 2026.

items.title: Show HN: Fata – Spaced repetition to fight skill rot from AI coding
items.author: djoume
items.text:
Hi HN, I'm Djoumé. I've been a developer for over 20 years, and like a lot of you I've been coding almost exclusively through an agent in the past few months.

It's been amazing to vibe code prototypes in any stack, but when it comes to building something reliable/scalable, I couldn't effectively guide the agent unless I knew the technology. And the scariest part is that I'm seeing a lot of my technical skills decreasing due to AI coding.

Reflecting on my jo
items.summary: Fata is a tool using spaced repetition to help developers maintain coding skills through daily sessions. It focuses on languages like Rust, CSS, and Python, blending AI-generated content with manual review. Launched in 2026, it aims to combat skill decay from AI-assisted coding.

items.title: An O(x)Caml book that runs
items.author: anirudh24seven
items.summary: An O(x)Caml book is "Developing Applications with Objective Caml," which covers OCaml programming and its applications. It is a comprehensive guide to OCaml, including functional and object-oriented programming. This book is a valuable resource for learning OCaml.

items.title: How memory safety CVEs differ between Rust and C/C++
items.author: nicoburns
items.summary: Rust's memory safety is enforced by its compiler, preventing many vulnerabilities seen in C/C++. C/C++ require manual memory management, leading to more frequent memory safety issues. Rust's strict rules make it more secure against memory-related exploits.

items.title: Factoring "short-sleeve" RSA keys with polynomials
items.author: ledoge
items.summary: Researchers developed a polynomial-based method to factor "short-sleeve" RSA keys, which have heavily biased zero bits, reducing the problem to polynomial factoring. This method uncovered hundreds of weak keys, many linked to a CompleteFTP bug. The vulnerability has been contained with updated software and tools.

items.title: Openrouter Fusion API
items.author: tdchaitanya
items.summary: OpenRouter Fusion API sends prompts to multiple models for combined responses, claiming superior performance at lower cost. It uses a judge model to synthesize answers, surpassing benchmark performance. Available for testing on OpenRouter's platform.
